text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard marketing permit located at 651 Gerrard Street East.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its April 4, 2018, meeting.
